Staff Vacancy
Saturday, 09 March 2019
9972 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital invites applications on plain paper for the following posts along with the attested copies of educational qualification and experience.
Posts :
1. Staff Nurse – 4 posts
2. OT Technician – 1 post
3. A.N.M. - 5 posts
The applicant should send their applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience  certificates/testimonials for the above posts to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) till
30/03/2019
.
Qualification & Experience :
(For Staff Nurse): Must have Diploma in Registered General Nursing and Midwifery and must possess valid registration from  Maharashtra Nursing Council and MSCIT with 2 years of experience in a 500 bedded Hospital.
(For OT Technician) : Graduate with Diploma in OT Technician with minimum 3 years experience in Neurosurgery OT of a 500 bed Hospital.
(For ANM): 12
th
+ Diploma as Auxillary Nurse & Midwifery with minimum 2 years experience in a 100 bedded
Age Limit:
30 years (Age and Experience shall be relaxed for an exceptional and suitable candidate)
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 201)
Email:
mspis@mgims.ac.in
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
